subject: [Sentinel] CameraNode disk low: Driveway went offline
body_text:
Driveway went offline

No heartbeat received in over 90 seconds.

This is YOUR hardware (the host machine running CameraNode), not
the Command Center's cloud disk.  When it fills, the CameraNode
will stop writing new local recordings — live streaming continues,
but recorded segments stop persisting.

What to do:
  - Lower the CameraNode's storage cap: in Settings, under the node's
    storage bar, click Change (CameraNode 0.1.79 or later).  Or use
    the Storage page of the node's own web dashboard.  The node
    deletes its oldest recordings to fit.
  - Or: free up space on the host by removing other files.
    Recordings live inside the node's encrypted database, so don't
    delete them by hand.
  - Or: expand the host's storage (mount a larger drive, swap
    the SD card on a Pi, etc.).

You'll get a follow-up email if the disk stays low after 6 hours.
Manage email alerts: https://example.test/settings#settings-notifications
Unsubscribe from CameraNode disk alerts: UNSUB-URL-PLACEHOLDER-7f3a

subject: [Sentinel] Admin access requested by a member
body_text:
Driveway went offline

No heartbeat received in over 90 seconds.

What this is:
  An in-app member of your organization clicked "Request admin
  access" from their dashboard.  Admin access lets a member add
  CameraNodes, generate MCP API keys, configure recording policies,
  and access the audit log — programmatic and write-capable
  privileges you may or may not want them to have.

How to act on it:
  Review the request, then either grant or deny in Clerk's
  organization settings:
    https://example.test/settings

  Clerk is the source of truth for roles — promoting in Clerk
  takes effect within ~60 seconds via JWT refresh.

If you don't recognize the requester:
  Audit your member list immediately at the link above.  An
  unexpected promotion request from someone you don't know is
  a signal worth investigating before acting.

——
This alert went only to organization admins.
Manage email alerts: https://example.test/settings#settings-notifications
Unsubscribe from member-audit alerts: UNSUB-URL-PLACEHOLDER-7f3a
body_html:

Driveway went offline

No heartbeat received in over 90 seconds.

What this is

  1. Open Settings (link below) and review your member list
  2. If approving, promote the requester to admin via Clerk — the change propagates to their JWT within ~60 seconds
  3. If declining, no action needed. The request stays in the audit log; the requester won't be notified directly
  4. If you don't recognize the requester, audit recent invitations before deciding

CameraNode disk low: garage-pi

Your Sentinel workspace is ready.  This is the command
center — a self-hosted-camera-feeds dashboard, AI-aware via the
MCP integration, with motion detection + incident reports baked in.

Three steps to your first live feed:

  1. In Settings, click "Add Your First Node".  Command Center
     creates the node and shows an install command with its key
     built in.

  2. Run that command on the computer your USB cameras are plugged
     into (Linux or macOS).  On Windows, install the MSI from
       https://example.test/downloads/windows/x86_64
     and enter the node ID and key when setup asks for them.

  3. CameraNode finds your cameras and registers them on its own.
     They appear on the dashboard within about a minute.

Open the dashboard:
  https://example.test/dashboard

Need a hand?  The full documentation lives at
https://sentinel-command.com/documentation/.  If you haven't installed
a CameraNode yet, start with "Install a CameraNode" under "Get started".
